evidence: src/domain/rules/holder-data-cleaning.ts ownerClassFromAccounts prioritizes exclusion classes over included_holder
aggregateOwners mixed re-eval only upgrades to unresolved when cleaningClass is NOT already an excluded class — which never happens when hasExclude is true
Offline probe (auditor, no network): pos+zero → owner class=zero_balance with raw=100 excluded; pos+closed → closed_or_inactive raw=150 excluded; pos+invalid → invalid_or_unparseable raw=100 excluded

findings.impact: Zero-balance or closed ATAs for a normal wallet can drop that owner from cleanedHolderUniverse and concentration numerators despite positive remaining balance.
findings.requiredFix: When an owner has any positive included_holder ATA: (a) keep owner included with sum of positive included amounts only, OR (b) mark owner unresolved_exclusion_candidate with manual-review issue — never silent whole-owner exclude for zero/closed/invalid siblings.

findings.title: Unparseable mixed owners are silently excluded instead of unresolved/manual review
evidence: No issue path forces unresolved_exclusion_candidate for include+invalid mix
findings.impact: Violates fail-closed manual-review requirement for unparseable mixed owners.
findings.requiredFix: include + invalid_or_unparseable on same owner → unresolved_exclusion_candidate + whetherManualReviewRequired=true; do not place positive residual solely in excludedInfrastructureUniverse.

findings.title: Incomplete pool/liquidity exclusion coverage still confirms holder concentration as judgment-eligible
evidence: gap-matrix.md: almost no infrastructure exclusions on live OK CAs; pool accounts stay included by design
OK CA H3Gtw…: judgmentEligible=true, holderUniverses.provenance.verificationStatus=confirmed, top10Concentration ratio=0.479158 completeness=1
judgmentEligible only gates pagination+supply residual+identity; no pool-exclusion-coverage signal
findings.impact: Owner aggregation and supply accounting may be complete, but Top10/Top20 can be read as cleaned investor concentration without pool exclusion evidence.
findings.requiredFix: Split states: accounting verification may remain complete when residual=0 and pages complete; holder-risk / concentration verificationStatus must stay unverified or explicitly scoped (e.g. accounting_only_no_pool_exclusion) until pool/liquidity exclusion coverage is first-hand complete.
